panels.description: Jesus releases his ball beneath the oversized GODARAZ z. One pin remains standing on lane 3. Keep upper-right lane space clear.
The power cuts and the machine stops. Walter, physically present, points at the standing pin while gripping his laminated rulebook. Keep the upper third open.

Pinty works on the noisy bicycle-chain linkage in the foreground while the standing pin remains visible in the lane beyond. Through the open doors, a small subordinate rectangle of tournament projection flickers on Bhatner’s whitewashed fort wall; it has no independent readable action. Keep the repair as the sharp focal point.
The machine lurches back to life. The standing pin remains under the lane light and a compact scoreboard clearly reads GODARAZ 48 — SAAND’S TEAM 48. Keep lower machine space clear.

items.speaker: WALTER
items.text: The frame was live. The pin stands. That is the score.
